parts:
Hi Everybody,
It was quite surprising to me that only a few weeks back there was lot
of noise in the group regarding the workshop on R and when we really
started putting efforts on this, the response drastically went down. I
must say it is more or less no response at all.

But i must thanks to Mr.Vinit Kaushik for his active participation in
the meeting today and we really had some good thoughts exchange. He
has seriously given a thought how to make this workshop a real
success. We have discussed the agenda, but due to very less
participation of people we were unable to come to a final conclusion.
So what we thought is we will post the agenda as we have decided and
depending on what you want from this workshop we will keep on updating
the agenda.

Unfortunately, there was no option in the skype where we can record
the call.But here is what we discussed:

(1) Who are the audiences, what are their skill sets and what is their
experience level and what they need from the workshop?

(2)Since we all are from different back ground and working in diverse
fields, so it is impossible to meet every one needs. As this is our
first workshop, so we will limit ourselves in certain areas. Our main
aim is to spread the awareness of R among the people.
So through this workshop we will try to answer some of the few
questions mentioned below:

(a) Even though the R is existing from years but then why it became so
much popular in recent years?
(b) Is it just because of the demand of some project people are
resorting to R?
(c) How is it different from other popular scripting languages like
Matlab?
(d) What is the reason that R has now emerging as a main stream
language?

(3)What are the different application areas where peoples are using R
and how R is used to solve their problems

(4) Well we know that R is not that simple language which a user new
to it can appreciate really. More over R being used in various areas,
so it is not possible for the beginner to explore its all
capabilities. So we discussed to take a tour through R.

(5) One important thing that Vinit has suggested is that we can start
taking up small projects on R. This will bring more exciting since
there will be lot of learning involved and more over it will bring
more insight.

Vinit can you please update the group if i have missed something??

Regards,
Som Shekhar
